claims: The first human moon landing occurred on July 20, 1969.
The first human moon landing was part of NASA's Apollo 11 mission.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Lunar Module Eagle in the Sea of Tranquility at 20:17 UTC.
The Apollo 11 landing date and time was July 20, 20:17:40 UTC.
Neil Armstrong's first step on the moon occurred on July 20 at 10:56 p.m. EDT.
Neil Armstrong's first step on the moon occurred early on July 21 UTC.
The Apollo 11 astronauts were Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins.
Michael Collins was orbiting during the Apollo 11 moon landing.
Apollo 11 returned to Earth on July 24, 1969.
Neil Armstrong's historic first step was accompanied by the phrase 'That's one small step for [a] man, one giant leap for mankind'.
